test_title: PYST 58: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Preeti starts from point A and drives 7 km towards South. From here, she takes a left turn and drives 9 km. She then takes a final left turn and drives 7 km to reach point B. How far should Preeti drive to reach point A from point B?
solution: According to the given information, 1) Preeti starts from point A and drives 7 km towards South. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70fb658b7de687090741cd0398bbdfd819569fd54b05ad65f4394f62f6e60ce2.png] 2) From here, she takes a left turn and drives 9 km.
